name: Ch’eng Kou
bio: Ch’eng Kou (程垓; Cheng Gou; 12th century) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 水龙吟 (Shui long yin)
poems.author: Ch’eng Kou
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
夜来风雨匆匆，故园定是花无几。
愁多愁极，等闲孤负，一年芳意。
柳困花慵，杏青梅小，对人容易。
算好春长在，好花长见，元只是、人憔悴。
回首池南旧事。
恨星星、不堪重记。
如今但有，看花老眼，伤时清泪。
不怕逢花瘦，只愁怕、老来风味。
待繁红乱处，留云借月，也须拼醉。
